text: Program Description Program Introduction Shanghai University is a comprehensive University featured in China’s national Double First-Class Initiative and the 211 Project. With over six decades of experience educating international students, it offers a highly globalized campus environment, distinguished faculty, a full spectrum of academic disciplines, and a well-established support system for international learners. The Pre-University program is a non-degree undergraduate preparatory Program for International Students offered by the College of International Education of Shanghai University. This program boosts international students’ Chinese competence and builds solid foundations in science and engineering, Humanities, Economics & Management. It helps students meet Chinese University undergraduate admission standards and transition smoothly into Shanghai University’s undergraduate studies. Course Content and Tracks (Science and Engineering) Course Schedule​ Tuition Fee: CNY 26,000 per semester *Note: The above fee covers tuition, CSCA test preparation, HSK mock tests, and undergraduate application guidance fees.
